command:
set -euo pipefail
echo '=== HARNESS INTERFACE ==='
date -Ins; hostname; whoami
echo '--- HELP ---'
python3 /home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/harness_aider.py --help 2>&1 | tail -120 || true
echo '--- ARGPARSE / ENTRYPOINT ---'
grep -nE 'ArgumentParser|add_argument|def main|__main__|auftrag|paket|visible|sichtbar|provider|model' /home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/harness_aider.py | tail -180 || true
echo '--- RELATED HARNESS FILES ---'
find /home/ai-core-node/.claude/star -maxdepth 1 -type f -iname 'harness*' -printf '%f\n' | sort
echo '=== END ==='
